functions.name: reactions
functions.description: One canonical reaction entity across issue/PR threads, issue conversation comments, pull request review comments, commit comments and releases. Subject database/node IDs remain distinct from issue numbers and repository identity. issue_thread includes pull requests because the Issues reactions endpoint serves both. Reactors are distinct from parent authors, reviewers and publishers; deleted actors remain unknown. Each route exhausts its subject collection; there is no repository-wide route. Parent relationships preserve navigation but are not approved for analytical enrichment, avoiding ambiguous subject roles and loss of reactions whose optional actor is unavailable. Forward issue/PR navigation uses presence of the typed pull_request marker object; nullable marker URLs are never used to guess parent kind.

metrics.name: reaction_count
metrics.comment: Current reaction identities attached to the selected subject, not distinct actors, parent records or historical reaction events.

metrics.name: reaction_reactor_count
metrics.comment: Distinct known reacting account identities. Deleted or unavailable reactors are excluded; non-additive across subjects and reaction symbols.

metrics.name: reaction_thumbsup_count
metrics.comment: Current +1 reactions only; no sentiment interpretation is assigned to other symbols.

metrics.name: reaction_thumbsdown_count
metrics.comment: Current -1 reactions only. Releases do not support this reaction symbol in the pinned API.

reaction_unknown_reactor_count.comment: Reaction rows whose reacting account ID is unavailable; these still contribute to reaction_count.
